description: List all custom fields defined in the workspace. Each field returns a `slug` (for example `regulator_comment`) alongside its `id`, `name`, and `type`. Put `{{field.<slug>}}` in the prompt text you send and Speak substitutes that field's value for the media before the model sees it. A slug is unique per company and never changes when the field is renamed, so prefer it over the field name. A field with no slug yet resolves by `id` in the same token.
